    static UNIFIED_DERIVE_SC_PROP: &str = "\
Usage: test sub [OPTIONS]

Options:

  -V, --version              Print version
";

                .action(ArgAction::Set)

fn get_app() -> Command {
    Command::new("myprog")
        .arg(
            Arg::new("GLOBAL_ARG")
                .long("global-arg")
                .help("Specifies something needed by the subcommands")
                .global(true)
                .action(ArgAction::Set)
                .default_value("default_value"),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("GLOBAL_FLAG")
                .long("global-flag")
                .help("Specifies something needed by the subcommands")
                .global(true)
                .action(ArgAction::Count),
        )
        .subcommand(Command::new("outer").defer(|cmd| cmd.subcommand(Command::new("inner"))))
}

sections.title: clap panics on developer error, exits gracefully on user error
sections.content: debug_asserts.rs runs build-time validation in debug builds only — invalid Command/Arg configs panic during development (duplicate ids, conflicting settings), while end-user input errors produce Error::exit with formatted output. Release builds skip the debug asserts entirely.
